title: Phase 18: two position-specific permutation families
timing: Frozen locally before phase-18 optimization/calibration; not an external preregistration. Prior phases known to analyst.
model: Two independent permutations of a..z: table 1 for first OR last literal character of each word, table 0 elsewhere. Singleton uses table 1. Spaces fixed. No homophony, sound assignment, resegmentation or combined initial/final model.
baseline: One permutation; same data, optimizer proposals/restarts and heldout score. Equal proposal count is not equal search difficulty.
language_models: Archived phase-10 space-aware training texts: Caesar for Latin; Inferno/Purgatorio for Italian. Controls are Pliny/Paradiso. Frozen models; no fitting on control plaintexts.
control_split: First complete lines up to 24000 letters for fit, all remaining lines for evaluation; split before encryption. Four keys per language/family on the same texts, not independent corpora.

calibration_gate.aggregation: All eight controls must pass for a family. Failure stops that family; no adaptive budget change in this protocol.

real_split: Same as phase 10: union of physical-leaf identifiers, sorted lexicographically, indices 0,5,10,... held out. Both faces stay together. Training capped in line order. Pages previously inspected, not analyst-unseen.
barriers: None tokens and line ends break spans. No quadgram bridges a barrier. Spans shorter than four characters including spaces are dropped for both models and accuracy denominators.
primary: ZL A/B separately, both candidate languages, both calibrated families. IT sensitivity on the same manuscript, not independent evidence.
null: Shuffle individual letters within each (physical_leaf, positional_role) pool, separately within the capped training split and full test split. Roles singleton/initial/final/interior. Preserve word lengths, line breaks, unknown positions and positional symbol counts. Same shuffle for both languages and families. Refit each model. ZL only.
null_limitation: Destroys many linguistic and nonlinguistic local constraints. Exceeding it detects sequential structure only; does not establish a positional cipher, language or translation. No p-value or multiplicity-adjusted discovery claim.
score: Heldout average negative log2 probability per four-character window including spaces; gain=single_bits-position_bits. Frequency penalty used only for training selection. Absolute scores across languages do not identify language.
provisional_followup_rule: A positive heldout gain exceeding all 19 same-group null gains in both ZL A and B, with positive IT sensitivities and >=99.5% symbol support, justifies a separate confirmatory study only. A stable legible grammar and external evidence remain required for any translation claim.
audit: Preserve every fitted key and decoded heldout output marked NOT_TRANSLATION, restart objectives, true-key control scores, hashes and failures. Independent Python rescore before interpretation.
